# Requirements Review Checklist: Agent Change Explanations

**Purpose**: Check the quality of the requirements (complete, clear, consistent, measurable) for the whole feature before task generation and implementation. Covers the agent interface, the UI, follow-up questions, the lifecycle, and the platform and SSH cases.
**Created**: 2026-10-14
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md) · [research.md](../research.md) · [data-model.md](../data-model.md) · [contracts/](../contracts/)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 - Does the spec say how the skill gets into `~/.claude/skills` (bundled with Orca and installed, or copied by the user)? And does it say who installs it on a remote SSH host? [Gap, Spec §FR-001, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK002 - Are the payload limits (1 MB, 500 items, 104 changes, 8192 characters per item) stated as requirements in the spec, or do they exist only in the contracts? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004, contracts/publish-payload.md]
- [ ] CHK003 - Does the spec say what happens when every item is rejected (nothing is published and the previous explanation is kept)? [Gap, Spec §FR-004, Spec §FR-022]
- [ ] CHK004 - Does the spec say how the producing agent's name is decided when the agent gives none (FR-005 "record which agent")? [Gap, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK005 - Are requirements written for a file that is in the explanation but is no longer in the live change set (for example, the change was reverted after publishing)? [Gap, Spec §FR-007, data-model.md §Change-set file row]
- [ ] CHK006 - Does the spec say where the "detached" list lives in the UI, and how a detached item can be reached and read? [Completeness, Spec §FR-024, Spec §US5-3]
- [ ] CHK007 - Does the spec say what the tab header shows: the agent, the generation time, the base used, and the "uncommitted changes only" fallback notice? [Completeness, Spec §US5-1, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK008 - Is a cap on follow-up questions (200 per set in storage-format.md) stated in the requirements, together with what the user sees when it is reached? [Gap, contracts/storage-format.md]
- [ ] CHK009 - Is there a requirement for editing a question that was already sent (keep the sent record and create a new draft)? [Gap, Spec §FR-018, data-model.md §FollowUpQuestion]
- [ ] CHK010 - Does the spec say whether clearing asks for confirmation, and whether agents can also clear (the plan has `orca explain clear`)? [Gap, Spec §FR-023]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK011 - Is the broken FR-001 wording ("works together with and a documented command interface") fixed, so it is clear what the skill depends on? [Ambiguity, Spec §Product Context, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK012 - Does "validate every anchor against the change set" say whether lines that exist in the file but did not change are accepted? (The research accepts them with an `outside_changed_hunk` warning.) [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-004, research.md §R4]
- [ ] CHK013 - Is "highlights or filters" in US1-6 settled into one behavior, and is it the same as "focus a single change" in FR-009? [Ambiguity, Spec §US1-6, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK014 - Does the spec define "best-matching line" and the line between "possibly outdated" and "detached", so the result can be checked objectively? [Clarity, Spec §FR-024]
- [ ] CHK015 - Does "still running" (agent preselection in US3-3) have a definition that matches the agent-status vocabulary (`live` / `unverifiable` / `exited`)? [Clarity, Spec §US3-3, Spec §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK016 - Is "the same options the diff-note flow offers" listed explicitly, or linked to a documented behavior, so the requirement can be checked on its own? [Clarity, Spec §US3-5, Spec §FR-019]
- [ ] CHK017 - Does the spec say what "inline popover" (Edge Cases) and "inline in the diff" (FR-013) mean? Are they the same surface, and is a maximum height or scroll rule given? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-013, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK018 - Is "subtly highlighted" (range edge case) tied to a design token or a style-guide role? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK019 - Does the spec's assumption that the skill is "not bundled with Orca's own skills" match the plan, which ships `skills/orca-explain/` and `skill-guides/` in the repo and installs them? [Conflict, Spec §Assumptions, plan.md §Project Structure, contracts/skill.md]
- [ ] CHK020 - Does the spec's concurrent-publish rule ("the earlier agent is told its explanation was replaced") match the contract? In the contract, `replacedPrevious` is only on the later caller's response and the earlier caller is not notified. [Conflict, Spec §Edge Cases, contracts/publish-payload.md]
- [ ] CHK021 - Does the binary/large-file edge case ("shown as a list without circles") match the contract, which rejects line anchors on those files with `line_anchor_unsupported` unless they are file-level? Should the spec name file-level items? [Consistency, Spec §Edge Cases, contracts/publish-payload.md]
- [ ] CHK022 - Is the change set ("branch vs base plus uncommitted") defined the same way in FR-004, FR-007, the Assumptions, and the diff the tab opens (merge-base → working tree)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004, Spec §FR-007, research.md §R3]
- [ ] CHK023 - Does US4-3 ("the note is visible there too") hold for notes on old-side (removed) lines and on branch-only changes, given that Source Control may show a different diff for that file? [Consistency, Spec §US4-3, research.md §R13]
- [ ] CHK024 - Are the label rules (FR-008, FR-010, FR-011, the >26 edge case) consistent with each other for a file that appears in several changes, and for duplicate file entries inside one change? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008, research.md §R6]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK025 - Does SC-002 (tab "within 2 seconds") say where the clock starts (the CLI returns, or the agent finishes) and which conditions apply (local or SSH, window in background)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK026 - Can SC-006 ("noticeably less effort") be checked objectively, or should it be marked as a non-gating dogfooding signal? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006]
- [ ] CHK027 - Does SC-001 name the platforms (macOS, Linux, Windows, WSL, SSH) the three agents must be checked on, to match FR-025? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001, Spec §FR-025]
- [ ] CHK028 - Does SC-004 ("none silently disappear") also cover items that are later detached by freshness changes, or only items at publish time? [Clarity, Spec §SC-004, Spec §FR-024]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK029 - Is next/previous behavior defined for detached items and for file-level items that have no marker to jump to? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK030 - Is marker placement defined for the inline (non side-by-side) diff layout, as well as side-by-side? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK031 - Is the behavior defined when the user switches workspaces, or the explanation is cleared or replaced, while the Explanations tab or an explanation card is open, including unsent question drafts? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §FR-006, Spec §FR-019]
- [ ] CHK032 - Is it defined what happens to a question draft or sent question when a new publish replaces the explanation while the user is writing? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec §FR-022]
- [ ] CHK033 - Are rename and copy cases defined for anchors on both sides (old path on the old side, new path on the new side)? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK034 - Are requirements written for the case where the workspace runs on a paired remote Orca runtime that does not support explanations (mixed versions)? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §FR-025, research.md §R8]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK035 - Are accessibility requirements given for the markers and the card: keyboard focus order, accessible names (for example "Explanation A1.1"), and keyboard shortcuts for next/previous on each platform? [Gap, Spec §FR-011, Spec §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK036 - Are rendering-safety requirements given for agent-written markdown (no raw HTML, link handling)? [Gap, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK037 - Does the spec address the fact that explanation text written by one agent is forwarded inside a prompt to another agent (prompt-injection risk) and say whether any marking or sanitizing is needed? [Gap, Security, Spec §FR-017]
- [ ] CHK038 - Are performance requirements given for marker layout in large diffs and for publish validation time (the plan has 5k lines and under 2 s for 50 files, the spec has none)? [Gap, plan.md §Technical Context]
- [ ] CHK039 - Are localization requirements (all new strings translatable) and design-system compliance stated for the new tab and card? [Gap, AGENTS.md]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK040 - Is the assumption that Copilot CLI and Pi read `~/.claude/skills` (or a linked `~/.agents/skills`) checked, with a fallback requirement if one of them does not? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions, research.md §R14]
- [ ] CHK041 - Is there a documented decision to use `AGENTS.md` as the constitution while `.specify/memory/constitution.md` is still the empty template? [Assumption, plan.md §Constitution Check]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
